title: A welcome arrival
task: Help a newcomer enter an unfamiliar shared space without a long onboarding tour.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Seam Ledger: boundary norms with visible decay and reversible repairs
synthesis.action: Newcomer taps a seam between zones, then accepts, questions, or reties its local norm.
synthesis.feedback: Each norm shows confidence, last-confirmed date, and source; stale ones fray with stated reason.
synthesis.mechanism: Norms live at boundaries; corrections enter an undoable ledger others confirm, linking uncertainty to delayed help.
synthesis.difference: Repair history, not shading, is the core interaction; uncertainty explains its source and decay.
synthesis.risks: Ledger may overwhelm; frayed norms could erode trust; scarce-resource norms may age unseen.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, fictional JSON norms, local storage ledger, no sensors or identities.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed: SVG floorplan, five seams, norm cards, retie and undo buttons, scripted decay clock.

proposals.title: Seam Map: tagged joints newcomers can loosen and retie
proposals.action: Newcomer taps visible seams between zones to reveal local norms.
proposals.feedback: Each seam shows confidence knots: tight, loose, or frayed uncertainty.
proposals.mechanism: Norms bind to joints; newcomers propose reversible ties, others confirm.
proposals.difference: Rules live at boundaries, not tours, with legible repair history.
proposals.risks: Frayed seams may overwhelm; stale ties could mislead quietly.
proposals.feasibility: Offline web prototype with fictional floorplan and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Clickable SVG map; seams toggle notes, undo log, retie button.

proposals.title: Tide Map Arrival
proposals.action: Newcomer drags a cup marker into zones of a fictional floor map.
proposals.feedback: Zones fill like basins showing norms; murky water marks uncertain guesses.
proposals.mechanism: Each confirmed question clears water; stale tips slowly silt over time.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is visible sediment, not hidden confidence or flat checklists.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; murkiness could feel like unreliable guidance overall.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with canvas and fictional JSON norms.
proposals.prototype: Clickable map, five zones, correct-or-flag button reshaping water clarity.

proposals.title: Stage Marks: chalk-line arrival map with confidence halos
proposals.action: Newcomer drags their token across a top-down floor plan to block entry.
proposals.feedback: Zones glow by fictional norm certainty; faint halos mean guessed conventions.
proposals.mechanism: Theatrical blocking marks suggest paths, pauses and where attention gathers.
proposals.difference: Spatial rehearsal replaces tours; uncertainty shown as fuzzy, not hidden.
proposals.risks: Misread halos may feel authoritative; floor plans may oversimplify social norms.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML canvas with fictional JSON room and norms.
proposals.prototype: Drag token, tap marks to correct or flag guessed norms.

proposals.title: Confidence Chalk Trails
proposals.action: Newcomer taps a habitat object to reveal its fading usage trail.
proposals.feedback: Trails glow solid when recent, dashed when uncertain or stale.
proposals.mechanism: Fictional logs render as decaying chalk lines newcomers can redraw or erase.
proposals.difference: Shows how sure the guidance is, not just where to go.
proposals.risks: Stale trails may mislead; newcomers may over-trust solid lines.
proposals.feasibility: Offline web canvas with scripted fictional logs and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Clickable habitat map; correction button marks trails wrong; untested.

synthesis.title: Ask-and-Vouch Doorway Questions
synthesis.action: Newcomer picks a question at each doorway, like 'Can I sit anywhere?', getting one answer.
synthesis.feedback: Answers carry text labels: known, likely, or unsure, plus who vouched in fictional history.
synthesis.mechanism: Newcomer vouches, disputes, or flags answers; conflicting corrections stay visible side by side, never silently overwritten.
synthesis.difference: Questions replace map styling; uncertainty is stated in words, and disputes surface instead of averaging away.
synthesis.risks: Too many unsure answers may erode trust; fictional vouch counts could feel falsely authoritative.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, fictional JSON questions, localStorage state, undo stack for every action.
synthesis.prototype: Keyboard-navigable three-doorway page with text labels and ARIA live region; plan to observe whether trust matches labels.

proposals.title: Confidence Lantern Map
proposals.action: Newcomer taps a mapped spot to ask what happens here.
proposals.feedback: Answers glow bright when certain, flicker faintly when guessed.
proposals.mechanism: Each fictional fact carries confidence; users confirm or correct it inline.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is shown visually, and user corrections reshape the map.
proposals.risks: Flickering cues may confuse users or erode trust in solid facts.
proposals.feasibility: Static offline HTML with local JSON and fictional data.
proposals.prototype: Clickable floorplan with confidence glow and a correct-this control.

proposals.title: Confidence Trail Cards
proposals.action: Newcomer taps a doorway card to reveal nearby norms, ranked by certainty.
proposals.feedback: Each norm shows solid, dashed, or faint border for confidence level.
proposals.mechanism: User marks norms confirmed or wrong, updating an explicit local state machine.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is visible and correctable, not hidden behind confident instructions.
proposals.risks: Faint norms may be ignored; fictional confidence could mislead users.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with fictional JSON and localStorage undo.
proposals.prototype: Clickable floor map with three rooms, norm cards, undo history panel.

proposals.title: Confidence Sketch Map
proposals.action: Newcomer taps a hand-drawn map zone to ask what happens there.
proposals.feedback: Answers show solid or dotted outlines reflecting how certain the guidance is.
proposals.mechanism: Newcomer drags fuzzy zones to correct, firming them into shared knowledge.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is drawn spatially, and correction is direct manipulation.
proposals.risks: Dotted lines may read as broken, or corrections may spread errors.
proposals.feasibility: Static offline web page with fictional zones and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper-then-HTML map; observe hesitation, taps, and correction attempts.

proposals.title: Confidence Doorway Walkthrough
proposals.action: Newcomer steps through rooms via arrow keys, hearing one tip each.
proposals.feedback: Each tip states confidence level: known, likely, or unsure-ask someone.
proposals.mechanism: Tips are claims the user can confirm, dispute, or mark outdated.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is spoken aloud and correctable, not hidden behind polish.
proposals.risks: Too many unsure tips may erode trust; error recovery needs testing.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with fictional room data and localStorage.
proposals.prototype: Keyboard-only map, ARIA live region, undo for every correction.
